clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within the ruins of Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200 is an automated cleaning device that continues to function amidst the chaos. By feeding it a grime-encrusted object scavenged from the subterranean halls along with a nominal coin fee, adventurers can restore salvaged trinkets, gems, and scrap to pristine condition. It stands as a vibrant testament to the enduring ingenuity and eccentricity of gnomish engineering.

Amidst the radioactive fallback and trogg infestation consuming Gnomeregan, a pocket of surviving gnomes maintains a secure perimeter near an extraordinary invention: the Sparklematic 5200. Built to scrub the harsh subterranean filth off salvaged valuables, this sturdy contraption promises to put the 'shine back in shine-tastic.' Even while subterranean monstrosities pound on the bulkheads, the machine sits ready for commercial operation.

The cleaning mechanism is anything but gentle. Once an adventurer deposits a grime-caked relic alongside three silver coins, the Sparklematic surges into a violent, churning frenzy. The entire iron apparatus groans, vibrates, and lurches from side to side as it strips away toxic sludge, irradiated grease, and rock dust. Moments later, it expels whatever was buried beneath the muck, ranging from precious minerals to mechanical components.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This contraption stands out amongst the gnomes holding out against the madness outside the room. A small plaque on the device reads "The Sparklematic 5200", followed by some text:

"Grime and residue ruining your sparklies? The Sparklematic 5200 puts the shine back in shine-tastic! Insert the item you wish to clean and deposit three silver coins in the coin slot. Give the Sparklematic 5200 a moment for operation, and voila! Your valuables will emerge clean and shiny!"

clips.title: Progress
paras: It would seem that the device needs some sort of grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to get the contraption working. So long as both are present, the Sparklematic 5200 should work...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You insert the grime-encrusted item and three silver coins into the Sparklematic 5200. The machine surges to life in a frenzied attempt to purge the grime from the unknown item. Loud, violent churning sounds beat from the heart of the machine. The metal frame of the beast creaks and groans as it lurches from side to side...

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
